assets.name: 스플린터 / SPLINTER
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original fictional firearm concept sprite for ORVASK, a dystopian industrial tower survival game. This is an art concept, not an engineering diagram. Output gun only, strict right-facing side elevation, centered and fully inside a wide landscape transparent RGBA canvas with a clean margin. NO character, hands, text, letters, labels, logo, background, scene, ground shadow, glow, smoke, bullets, technical drawings or extra views.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 Ratchet and Image2 Rivet are the chosen weapon family: matte scavenged industrial parts, limited faded paint, dark desaturated steel, restrained cloth/wood grip, irregular but solid practical silhouettes. They are STYLE references, NOT guns to copy or recolor. Image3 is the approved character's low-contrast grouped PIXEL STYLE; do not include the character. All new guns must share this chunky subdued pixel treatment.
RENDERING: true coarse pixel art, roughly a100-pixel-wide underlying sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Crisp stepped edges, a few large flat color/shadow clusters, deliberately sparse highlights and wear. Five to seven large color/value groups, low contrast interior planes, selective dark outline matching character weight. No microscopic scratches, tiny screws, dense rails, thin bright outlines, gradient metallic rendering, soft halo or bloom. The actual background must be transparent, including holes in the silhouette. Art should look hand-placed and calm, with one memorable large structure. Salvaged pressed plates and cast hardware, not decorative brass steampunk and not sleek modern tactical gun. A compact held object, never an oversized cannon.

SUBJECT — SPLINTER: two-handed compact scattergun, broader and shorter than Ratchet. Memorable silhouette is a short wide trapezoidal FRONT SHROUD whose top and bottom protective plates flare outward just slightly, leaving a single heavy blunt barrel visible between them. No trumpet mouth, no sharp bayonets and no multibarrel minigun. A squat rounded breech in the middle, large simple side latch, short solid wedge-shaped shoulder stock at left, downward diagonal main grip at about35%width, thick horizontal pump/fore-end under the barrel at about70%width with space for the supporting hand. A low, compact box ammunition housing near the breech, no long dangling magazine or hose. Shape feels like old crowd-control hardware repaired for scavenging. Main casing faded dusty ochre paint over charcoal steel; one desaturated grey-green repair plate at rear, dark worn brown stock/grip, minimal cream wear. Keep the forward flaring silhouette clear even as a tiny inventory icon. Pure horizontal profile facing right. Suggested overall silhouette width-to-height about3.2:1. One whole gun.
